messages:
maria: quick run-through: new compact probe row for the on-prem network checks. goal: single-line footprint for small screens, but still screen-reader friendly. attached: https://assets.redwood.dev/ui/compact-probe-row.png. thoughts? lee: Love the density, but worried about SR verbosity. Right now each probe updates like: ``` Probe: SSH - Running Probe: SSH - Success ``` which VoiceOver will read twice per probe. owen: Could we collapse micro-updates and only expose the human readable status via a role=status node? e.g. render the UI progress visually but surface a single status string: 'SSH probe succeeded, 3 of 7 checks complete'. sara: For copy alternatives on that status line: - Option 1: 'Running network checks 12% complete' - Option 2: 'Verifying network checks 12% complete' - Option 3: 'Network checks in progress 12% (3/7)'. lee: prefer Option 3 but drop the percent when we don't have reliable progress. percent gives false confidence for indeterminate probes. maria: UX nit: the compact row hides the host label behind an icon tooltip on hover. On mobile that tooltip is inaccessible. Let's make device/host name visible at narrow widths (truncate with ellipsis). owen: Implementation detail: use data attributes and one live region: ```html
host-a-12...
Network checks in progress (3/7)
``` This avoids repeatedly toggling aria-pressed or aria-valuenow. sara: Error state wording proposals when a probe fails due to timeout: - 'Network probe timed out 14 Retry probe or run diagnostics' - 'Connection timed out 14 Try again or view troubleshooting steps' Keep the primary CTA 'Retry probe' and secondary 'View diagnostics'. lee: Accessibility trap: make sure retry buttons have clear aria-labels like 'Retry SSH probe for host-a-12' so screen reader users know which host they affect. maria: dev/tests: can we add a query param to simulate flaky probes? e.g. ?simulate_probe_delay=slow so UX can test SR announcements. owen: will add that behind a feature flag. Also adding a small live demo page for QA: /staging/probe-demo. deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploys.redwood-inference/pr/478 includes compact row, single status live region, and copy variants. QA checklist appended to PR.
